name: Obsidian
desc: Deep black with refined violet light. Tools are named Persona, Imagine, Motion and Voice, each with a plain-English line underneath. A grouped left sidebar on web, a floating dock with a centre Create button on mobile.

name: Clay
desc: Puffy 3D tiles on dark plum, with one pastel colour per tool so people learn the app by colour. Bolt, a small robot guide, keeps the wording warm and simple.
nav: Floating clay sidebar · puffy mobile dock

name: Halo
desc: The work sits in the centre. You type in a chat-style prompt bar at the bottom, settings open in a popover, and a macOS-style dock works on every screen. Your selfies orbit your face as you upload.

name: Atelier
desc: A fashion-magazine feel: serif headlines, hairline rules, numbered tools and sharp corners. Identity is a contact sheet, images come back as plates, and the voice tool is written like a screenplay.
nav: Numbered top navigation · minimal mobile tab bar
type: Instrument Serif + Inter Tight + Plex Mono

name: Console
desc: Dense and keyboard-first. Project tabs, a dashboard, full parameter control, and a live render queue that fills as you generate. The editor has V1/T1/A1/A2 tracks and lock and visibility controls.
nav: Slim icon rail + project tabs · mobile tab bar

name: Prism
desc: Inspired by spatial interfaces: frosted windows over a blurred photo of the tool you are in, with round app icons. Every tool asks one simple question per screen, with Back and Continue.
nav: Floating side ornament · bottom pill on mobile
best: The easiest possible flow for anyone
